Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any chosen item or minion based on their texture or material, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it.
Changelog: Fixed patches of light across the shaded side of the fur trims, shaped like the legs or whatever else lies behind the coat's opening. They came from the 0.6.0 fix for fur around a tail lying on the coat, which also picked up surfaces far behind the fur. That fix now only counts what lies right under the fur.
